    ull res = 1;
    while (exp) {
        if (exp & 1ULL) res = res * base % MOD;
        base = base * base % MOD;
        exp >>= 1ULL;
    }
    return res;
}

inline ull binom(int a, int b) {

    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i)
